# ibee_firewall_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a VM to a firewall group. Import as firewall_group_id/vm_id.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_firewall_attachment" "web" {
  firewall_group_id = "FIREWALL_GROUP_ID"
  vm_id             = "VM_ID"
}
```
